meta.name: add-rtk
meta.description: Install rtk token-compression proxy into agent containers. Routes Bash tool calls through rtk for 60–90% token savings on dev commands (git, cargo, pytest, docker, kubectl, etc.).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在容器中安装 rtk 代理以压缩令牌，节省开发命令的令牌消耗
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果使用 AI 辅助开发且想减少令牌消耗
copy.tagline_en: Install rtk proxy in containers to compress tokens and save on dev commands
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use AI-assisted development and want to reduce token usage

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 每次通过 Bash 工具运行命令时,命令会先经过 rtk 代理压缩,再实际执行,可节省约 60%–90% 的 token。git、cargo、pytest、docker、kubectl 等开发命令均适用。
howto.when: 当 Claude 要通过 Bash 工具执行命令时触发。比如运行 git status、cargo build、pytest 等开发命令;命令会自动交给 rtk 先压缩再执行。

say.text: 用 Bash 运行 git status 看看仓库状态
say.note: 命令会被 rtk 拦截压缩再执行

say.text: 用 Bash 执行 cargo build 编译项目
say.note: 同样走 rtk 压缩,节省 token

say.text: 用 Bash 跑一下 pytest 测试
say.note: rtk 会静默接管这条命令

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude routes every Bash tool call through the rtk proxy before executing it, saving 60–90% of tokens on common dev commands like git, cargo, pytest, docker, kubectl.
howto.when_en: Triggered whenever Claude runs a command via the Bash tool, e.g. git status, cargo build, or pytest. The command is transparently filtered through rtk first.

say_en.text: Run git status via Bash to check the repo state.
say_en.note: The command is intercepted and compressed by rtk.

say_en.text: Run cargo build via Bash to compile.
say_en.note: Also filtered through rtk to save tokens.

say_en.text: Run pytest via Bash to execute tests.
